seo_title: How to Prepare for Your Food Tour
seo_description: Prepare for your Simply Enak food tour in Malaysia. What to wear, what to bring, dietary notes, and what to expect.
hero_title: How to Prepare for Your Food Tour
hero_description: What to wear, what to bring, and what to expect. For both join-in and private tours.

whatToWear.title: Closed-toe shoes
whatToWear.description: Wet floors get slippery. Sandals are asking for trouble.

whatToWear.title: Cover up
whatToWear.description: Malaysia is a modest country, especially around markets and temples. Shoulders and knees.

whatToWear.title: Light clothes
whatToWear.description: Hot and humid all year. Something breathable.

whatToWear.title: Bring umbrella if rain looks likely
whatToWear.description: Afternoon rain is common October to March. Small umbrella fits in your pocket.

whatToWear.title: Not white
whatToWear.description: You will spill food on yourself. Darker colours hide mess.

whatToWear.title: Sunscreen and hat
whatToWear.description: Malaysian sun is brutal. You will be outside for hours.

whatToBring.title: Water bottle
whatToBring.description: Refill it at the stops. Skip the plastic cups.

whatToBring.title: Cash for souvenirs
whatToBring.description: Your tour covers all food and drinks. Bring cash for souvenirs.

whatToBring.title: Phone or camera
whatToBring.description: Markets are crowded. Do not drop it in curry.

whatToBring.title: Small bag
whatToBring.description: So your hands are free for eating.

whatToExpect.title: Small groups
whatToExpect.description: Join-in tours are 7 people max. Private tours are just your group.

whatToExpect.title: 3-4 hours of eating
whatToExpect.description: 6-8 stops. Skip breakfast before you come.

whatToExpect.title: 1-2 km of walking
whatToExpect.description: Slow pace. Lots of stops to eat and listen.

whatToExpect.title: Rain or shine
whatToExpect.description: We go in all weather. You will get wet.

whatToExpect.title: Guide orders for you
whatToExpect.description: No menus. Your guide picks favourite dishes. Just say what you cannot eat.

dietary_intro: Let us know what you can and cannot eat when you book. Vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free. We handle it.
directions_cta_text: Need help finding the meeting point?
